name: Say Yah!
source:
Old man Klaus could not stand up after a night with prostitute Aria. Aria had nothing to do, but to work in his stead. Aria together with reindeer distributes presents to common people who have problems with sex. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
克劳斯老人和妓女阿里亚度过一夜后站不起来了。阿里亚无事可做，只好代替他工作。阿里亚和驯鹿一起为有性问题的普通人分发礼物。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
